Nvidia pauses AI server shipments to Southeast Asia amid export compliance review

• Nvidia halted AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian nations while reviewing export compliance.
• Kagi Mail provides private, ad-free email with optional AI tools, costing $9-monthly or $25-monthly for full features.
• SpaceX cleared to deploy up to 1 million AI satellites, with the first launch required by November 2033.

items.text:
Nvidia blocks 24% of China’s AI compute route in Southeast Asia.

• Nvidia asked partners like Dell and Super Micro to pause AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia.
• The pause targets about 24% of China’s AI computing power that ran through those data centres.
